_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: The McGraw-Hill Companies 'is a leading global information services provider serving the financial, education, commercial and commodities markets with the information they need to succeed in the “Knowledge Economy”' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of debt securities issued in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and other volatility in the financial markets could have a material impact on our results of operations', and under 'Our education businesses operate in a cyclical environment' 'Our School Education Group and the industry it serves are influenced strongly by the magnitude and timing of state adoption opportunities' (the education businesses' adoption cycle, not the company's own earnings called cyclical); a fall in debt issuance, state adoptions or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: The McGraw-Hill Companies 'is a leading global information services provider serving the financial, education, commercial and commodities markets with the information they need to succeed in the “Knowledge Economy”' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of debt securities issued in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and other volatility in the financial markets could have a material impact on our results of operations', and under 'Our education businesses operate in a cyclical environment' 'Our School Education Group and the industry it serves are influenced strongly by the magnitude and timing of state adoption opportunities' (the education businesses' adoption cycle, not the company's own earnings called cyclical); a fall in debt issuance, state adoptions or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.74x; +7% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.12; conservative 2yr +17%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -14.6%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.2%/yr (Q3 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.9%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +15.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MHP (retrospective, 2012-11-09) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.74x (42.9% downside to Bear $29 / +57.6% upside to Bull $80) | Adj composite 2.19 vs market 2.31: gap -0.12 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +7% above the EPP floor $47 (14x FY12E $3.38) | Conservative 2-yr case: +17.4% total (+8.7%/yr) | At 15.0x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $67 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Financial Services revenue +18.2% in Q3 2012, forward revenues +2.4% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2012 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
